PercentBased.description: Product: ALL Description: True if the markup is expressed as a percentage.

Percent.description: Product: ALL Description: Markup amount expressed as a percent of charges already entered in the current transaction. To enter a rate of 10% use 10.0, not 0.01.

PriceLevelRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to a PriceLevel for the markup.

MarkUpIncomeAccountRef.description: Product: ALL Description: An account associated with markup info. Cannot be updated or modified.
